desc:
Clutching a wavering ideal.
Running and shouting across the barren red earth, then falling into sleep, only to wake up grown.
Choosing chains of one's own making.
Living on as a blade, scraping by. Investigating, interrogating, hunting... endless, numb, cold.
Waiting for the promised judgment.
Plucking a rotting new bud and stepping into winter, until at last welcoming life's final hope... death, warm and peaceful.
desc2: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: Carry out judgment until the end comes.
name: Frostfall Sickle

1.desc: When an <color=#98EFF0>Ice attribute</color> equipper uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, their <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> is increased by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times, once per use of a skill. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. At 2 stacks, the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG dealt is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.
1.name: Terminating Verdict
